scenes.visual: Title card: Kill a Guidepost.

scenes.tts: A growth cone touches a cell just before it turns. Does it need that cell to make the turn?
scenes.visual: A growth cone touches a round cell at a bend, then turns. The question appears as on-screen text.
scenes.narration: A growth cone touches a cell just before it turns. Does it need that cell to make the turn?

scenes.tts: The worked case is the leg of a grasshopper embryo.
scenes.visual: A schematic grasshopper embryo with one developing leg highlighted (labelled AI illustration).
scenes.narration: The worked case is the leg of a grasshopper embryo.

scenes.tts: Near the tip of the leg sits a pair of sensory neurons called T i one.
scenes.caption: Near the tip of the leg sits a pair of sensory neurons called Ti1.
scenes.visual: Zoom to the leg tip. Two neurons are labelled Ti1.
scenes.narration: Near the tip of the leg sits a pair of sensory neurons called Ti1.

scenes.tts: They send the first axons toward the central nervous system. In the far part of the leg, no earlier axons lie ahead.
scenes.visual: Two axons grow from the Ti1 pair through the distal leg toward the body. Label: pioneers of the distal leg.
scenes.narration: They send the first axons toward the central nervous system. In the far part of the leg, no earlier axons lie ahead.

scenes.tts: So they are pioneers there. Nearer the body, they join stretches pioneered by other neurons.
scenes.visual: Farther toward the body, a short stretch of earlier axons from other neurons; the Ti1 axons join it.
scenes.narration: So they are pioneers there. Nearer the body, they join stretches pioneered by other neurons.

scenes.tts: Their route has several turns. At some sit young neurons that the growth cones touch just before turning.
scenes.visual: The route is drawn with several turns. Small young neurons sit at some of the turns.
scenes.narration: Their route has several turns. At some sit young neurons that the growth cones touch just before turning.

scenes.tts: At one of these turns sits a pair of cells called C x one.
scenes.caption: At one of these turns sits a pair of cells called Cx1.
scenes.visual: One turn is highlighted. Two cells are labelled Cx1. The growth cones touch them, then turn.
scenes.narration: At one of these turns sits a pair of cells called Cx1.

scenes.tts: But touching is not needing. The growth cones might touch C x one and turn there for some other reason.
scenes.caption: But touching is not needing. The growth cones might touch Cx1 and turn there for some other reason.
scenes.visual: On-screen text: touching is not needing.
scenes.narration: But touching is not needing. The growth cones might touch Cx1 and turn there for some other reason.

scenes.tts: David Bentley and Michael Caudy asked the direct question, in nineteen eighty-three.
scenes.caption: David Bentley and Michael Caudy asked the direct question, in 1983.
scenes.visual: Title text: Bentley and Caudy, 1983.
scenes.narration: David Bentley and Michael Caudy asked the direct question, in 1983.

scenes.tts: They selectively destroyed the C x one cells before the pioneer growth cones arrived.
scenes.caption: They selectively destroyed the Cx1 cells before the pioneer growth cones arrived.
scenes.visual: The two Cx1 cells are marked, then removed from the turn. The pioneer growth cones are still further down the leg.
scenes.narration: They selectively destroyed the Cx1 cells before the pioneer growth cones arrived.

scenes.tts: If C x one is only on the way, the route should look normal. If it is needed, the route should go wrong at that turn.
scenes.caption: If Cx1 is only on the way, the route should look normal. If it is needed, the route should go wrong at that turn.
scenes.visual: Split screen. Left: a normal route, labelled only on the way. Right: a route going wrong at the turn, labelled needed.
scenes.narration: If Cx1 is only on the way, the route should look normal. If it is needed, the route should go wrong at that turn.

scenes.tts: Which happened?
scenes.visual: On-screen text: Which happened?
scenes.narration: Which happened?

scenes.visual: Hold on the split screen. A small timer icon.

scenes.tts: The pioneers failed to take the normal route. They sent branches in abnormal directions.
scenes.visual: The real result: at the empty turn, the pioneer axons branch in several wrong directions.
scenes.narration: The pioneers failed to take the normal route. They sent branches in abnormal directions.

scenes.tts: At this turn, the growth cones need C x one.
scenes.caption: At this turn, the growth cones need Cx1.
scenes.visual: Label over the turn: needed here.
scenes.narration: At this turn, the growth cones need Cx1.

scenes.visual: Hold on the branching pioneers.

scenes.tts: The conclusion is narrow, and that is its strength. At this turn, in this preparation, these cells are needed.
scenes.visual: A tight frame around the one turn. On-screen text: this turn, this preparation.
scenes.narration: The conclusion is narrow, and that is its strength. At this turn, in this preparation, these cells are needed.

scenes.tts: It does not say whether C x one provides adhesion or a signal.
scenes.caption: It does not say whether Cx1 provides adhesion or a signal.
scenes.visual: Two question-marked icons beside the turn: adhesion, signal.
scenes.narration: It does not say whether Cx1 provides adhesion or a signal.

scenes.tts: Later work by Caudy and Bentley showed that the full route is built from several legs.
scenes.visual: The whole intact route, divided into coloured legs.
scenes.narration: Later work by Caudy and Bentley showed that the full route is built from several legs.

scenes.tts: Some legs are read from guideposts. Others are read from boundaries in the surrounding tissue.
scenes.visual: Legs coloured by what is read: one ends at the Cx1 pair, another follows a tissue boundary line.
scenes.narration: Some legs are read from guideposts. Others are read from boundaries in the surrounding tissue.

scenes.tts: So a guidepost is one important cue among several.
scenes.visual: On-screen text: one important cue among several.
scenes.narration: So a guidepost is one important cue among several.

scenes.tts: A choice point is a place where the growth cone picks its next path.
scenes.visual: Rule card from chapter one. The dots at each turn pulse: choice point.
scenes.narration: A choice point is a place where the growth cone picks its next path.

scenes.tts: A guidepost cell is one way to guide that choice.
scenes.visual: The Cx1 pair sits on one of the dots.
scenes.narration: A guidepost cell is one way to guide that choice.

scenes.tts: Remove one guidepost, and the pioneers lose their normal route at that turn.
scenes.visual: Takeaway card: remove the guidepost, lose the turn; a guidepost is one cue among several.
scenes.narration: Remove one guidepost, and the pioneers lose their normal route at that turn.

scenes.visual: Hold on the takeaway card.
